findings.evidence: We gather personal information to an extent deemed appropriate for the general operation of our digital portal and the delivery of requested functionalities.

To enhance our commercial outreach, sensitive categories including health records, religious affiliations, and biometric identifiers are processed under our legitimate business interests to tailor promotional campaigns and are made accessible across all operational departments.
